usedFor: Shopify collects customer emails; ApyHub checks them. A “New Customer” style event, or an “Abandoned Checkout”, can run “Validate Email” so you know the address is real.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Validate Email” in ApyHub
bestTemplate.why: The checkout carries an email, and “Validate Email” checks its format and MX records so recovery messages only go to deliverable addresses.

watchOut: “Validate Email” blocks disposable emails unless you turn that off, so real test addresses can fail. “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the check follows the next poll.
